ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution localized in distinct patches and stippling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity amorphous patch on the distal portion of the left lobe; extensive distribution of small circular high-intensity spots (stippling) across the central and medial regions of both lobes; concentrated multi-tonal mottling at the right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 135 degrees; vertical notch depth is approximately 5% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitudes vary from 4 to 18 pixels with highest peak density on the mid-to-outer thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to irregular, heavily textured distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial clusters of high-contrast, multi-tonal pixel groups on both distal tips; scattered white circular pixel aggregates distributed across the dark field of the medial lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions with diagonal orientation visible on the medial surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular geometric protrusions and multi-tonal clusters at the lateral extremities of both lobes, altering the natural linear boundary of the tips.
